run_read_command_line: run read_command_line to parse argparse CLI args for EgoNLQ data, model, and training config
build_argparse_parser: build an argparse parser with 30+ arguments for video-language grounding model training and evaluation
configure_model_parameters: configure model parameters like word_dim, video_feature_dim, hidden size, and predictor type via CLI
set_training_options: set training options including epochs, batch_size, learning rate, and gradient clip norm via CLI
parse_gpu_device_args: parse GPU device arguments including cuda_base and comma-separated device_ids for multi-GPU training
